def_en: 1) from, out of, on account of, off, on the side of, since, above, than, so that not, more than
1a) from (expressing separation), off, on the side of
1b2) (of material from which something is made)
1g) than, more than, too much for (in comparisons)
1h) from, on account of, through, because (with infinitive)
kjv: above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, [idiom] neither, [idiom] nor, (out) of, over, since, [idiom] then, through, [idiom] whether, with.
expl: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
